terminus.title: Terminus
terminus.definition: A station where one or more scheduled Southeastern passenger services regularly originate or terminate.

not_terminus.title: Not a Terminus
not_terminus.definition: A station where no scheduled Southeastern passenger service regularly originates or terminates.

interchange.title: Interchange
interchange.definition: A station where passengers can conveniently change between two or more route groups, or between services operated by different transport networks. This includes major destination terminals where passengers can connect between the game network and another operator.

direct_to_london_terminal.title: Direct to...
direct_to_london_terminal.definition: A station served by a scheduled passenger service operating directly to the specified London terminus without requiring a change of train.

high_speed.title: High Speed 1
high_speed.definition: A station where scheduled Southeastern Highspeed services call.

coastal.title: Coastal
coastal.definition: A station serving a coastal town, port or settlement located on or immediately adjacent to the sea.

east_kent.title: East Kent
east_kent.definition: A region covering the eastern part of Kent, including Ashford, Dover, Folkestone and surrounding communities.

canterbury_district.title: Canterbury District
canterbury_district.definition: A region centred on Canterbury and the surrounding communities served by the Kent Downs and East Kent railway corridors.

medway.title: Medway
medway.definition: A region covering the Medway towns and surrounding communities centred on the River Medway.

north_kent.title: North Kent
north_kent.definition: A region covering stations along the North Kent corridor between South East London, Dartford and the Medway area.

south_east_london.title: South East London
south_east_london.definition: A region covering stations within South East London and its immediate suburban area.

thanet.title: Thanet
thanet.definition: A region covering the Isle of Thanet, including Margate, Ramsgate, Broadstairs and neighbouring communities.

weald.title: Weald
weald.definition: A region covering stations in the rural Weald of Kent and Sussex, including the Tonbridge, Tunbridge Wells, Maidstone and Hastings corridors.

inner_london.title: Inner London
inner_london.definition: A station located within Central London or a major inner-London interchange served by the game network.

outer_suburban.title: Outer Suburban
outer_suburban.definition: A station serving a suburban, rural or regional community beyond Inner London.

high_service_frequency.title: High Service Frequency
high_service_frequency.definition: A major London, Greater London or principal commuter hub station served by a very high frequency of scheduled passenger services throughout the day.

many_routes.title: Many Routes
many_routes.definition: A station served by a wide variety of route groups, providing access to multiple distinct service corridors.

three_plus_routes.title: 3+ Routes
three_plus_routes.definition: A station served by three or more route groups.

contains.title: Contains...
contains.definition: A station whose name contains the specified word or text string. For example, a station matching 'Contains Hill' includes 'hill' anywhere within its name.

one_word_name.title: One Word
one_word_name.definition: Station name consists of a single word.

multiple_word_name.title: Multiple Words
multiple_word_name.definition: Station name consists of two or more words.

nature_word.title: Nature Word
nature_word.definition: Station name contains a landscape, vegetation or natural feature term such as Wood, Hill, Green or Park.

compass_direction.title: Compass Direction
compass_direction.definition: Station name contains a cardinal direction such as North, South, East or West.

settlement_word.title: Settlement Word
settlement_word.definition: Station name contains a settlement or transport-related term such as Road, Street, Gate, Cross or Bridge.

religious_word.title: Religious Word
religious_word.definition: Station name contains a religious or ecclesiastical term such as St, Saint, Abbey, Priory or Church.

under_60_mins.title: Under 60 mins from London
under_60_mins.definition: A station with a representative journey time of less than 60 minutes from Central London.

60_90_mins.title: 60–90 mins from London
60_90_mins.definition: A station with a representative journey time between 60 and 90 minutes from Central London.

over_90_mins.title: Over 90 mins from London
over_90_mins.definition: A station with a representative journey time greater than 90 minutes from Central London.

branch_line.title: Branch Line
branch_line.definition: A station located on a branch line or secondary route rather than a principal main line corridor, often serving a local destination or terminating route.

main_line.title: Main Line
main_line.definition: A station located on a principal main line corridor carrying long-distance, inter-regional or high-frequency services.

multiple_london_terminals.title: Multiple London Terminals
multiple_london_terminals.definition: A station served by direct passenger services to two or more London terminal stations.

commuter.title: Commuter
commuter.definition: A station located within the principal commuter network served by regular passenger services to and from London.

route_group.title: Route Group
route_group.definition: An operational corridor or service grouping used to classify stations within the game network.

journey_time.title: Journey Time
journey_time.definition: A representative scheduled journey time from Central London used for clue classification.

region.title: Region
region.definition: A geographical area used to group stations within the game network.
